minimum_review_evidence: Official document identity, verified version/effective date/supersession, exact clause/page, declared scope and reviewer rationale
notes: No person is assigned by this matrix.

minimum_review_evidence: Exact underlying clause/page, interpretation rationale, stated jurisdiction and conflicting interpretations
notes: Technical interpretation cannot alter formal rule text.

minimum_review_evidence: Official educational identity, exact page/section, population and teaching scope, limitations and transfer rationale
notes: Educational authority is separate from competition regulation and science.

minimum_review_evidence: Exact precaution wording and location, applicable technique/population, evidence class and non-medical limitation
notes: Must not become injury prediction or diagnosis.

minimum_review_evidence: Exact safety statement/location, facility/population scope, hazard controls and escalation boundary
notes: Training-environment safety is separate from technique biomechanics.

minimum_review_evidence: Exact source/page, population, clinical boundary, evidence basis, contraindications and medical attestation
notes: Discovery or non-medical review cannot satisfy this scope.

minimum_review_evidence: Exact source/page, population, clinical criteria, decision ownership, limitations and current-version evidence
notes: No individualized return-to-play decision may be generated.

minimum_review_evidence: Canonical source text, exact version/clause/page, bilingual comparison, terminology decisions and unresolved ambiguity log
notes: Translation review cannot decide regulatory or scientific validity.

minimum_review_evidence: Domain-approved source mapping, exact limitations, selected-language contract and fail-closed presentation review
notes: Product wording review occurs only after applicable domain review.
